en: A sepia-toned vintage postcard depicting a street view with older European-style buildings lining the left side. Notable is a prominent corner building with a pointed turret and signage reading 'Apotheke' (pharmacy in German). There is a railway or tram track separated from the road by a fence, and leafless trees line the street. The street is labeled as 'Bahnhofstraße.' The upper right corner of the postcard is captioned 'Weinböhla — Bahnhofstraße.'
